title: Fix remove 'WebSocketServerExtensionHandler' from pipeline after upgrade

timeline.message: Fix remove 'WebSocketServerExtensionHandler' from pipeline after successful handshake
timeline.author: Andrey Mizurov

timeline.body:
Motivation:

We should remove`WebSocketServerExtensionHandler` from pipeline after successful WebSocket upgrade even if the client has not selected any extensions.

Fixes #9939.
Can one of the admins verify this patch?

Can we split this condition on 2 separate if's? So we can perform only 1 class cast:

`((HttpResponse) msg).headers()`

`HttpResponse response = (HttpResponse) msg;`

Also, `response.headers()` could be moved to variable.

timeline.author: Andrey Mizurov

timeline.message: Fix test and remove handler by instance
timeline.author: Andrey Mizurov
